shortDescription: Renewed energy price increases pushed Irish annual consumer price inflation higher to 3.7% in August from 3.4% the previous month, in line with a flash estimate, Central Statistics Office data showed on Thursday.Prices were 0.7% higher month-on-month, the fastest monthly increase since March.
